module: Manages the axis gizmo (move / rotate / scale) of the Dynamic Decals tool. Other modules (decal, path, group...) choose the mode with setTransformMode, install their translateFn / rotateFn / scaleFn callback, and update M.transform. On each edit frame, editModeUpdate displays the gizmo, the bounding box of the selected decal and a debug sphere.
notes: Callbacks translateFn / rotateFn / scaleFn: called during the drag with the matrix returned by editor.getAxisGizmoTransform(); if they are nil, a "not yet implemented" message is written to the log.
The first call of gizmoDragging (dragCount == 1) is ignored.
Bug: editModeUpdate tests `data and data.debugObjPos` with the global `data` (not defined here, M.data is not used); the debug sphere therefore never appears, unless a global `data` exists.

M.data describes the manipulated object: uid, type ("drag", "rotate"...), objectType ("decal", "group", "path", "path_dataPoint"), optional dataPointIndex, objectDataCopy (state at the start of the drag). It is not filled by this module.

data.desc: Information about the object being manipulated (uid, type, objectType, dataPointIndex, objectDataCopy), filled by the calling modules.

translateFn.desc: Translation callback, receives the gizmo matrix.

setTransformMode.desc: Sets the transform mode; with none, the gizmo is no longer displayed.

resetTransformFn.desc: Resets translateFn, rotateFn and scaleFn to nil.

getDragCount.desc: Number of drag updates since the start of the current drag.

gizmoBeginDrag.desc: Callback passed to editor.updateAxisGizmo: called when the gizmo drag starts. Resets the counter to 0.

gizmoEndDrag.desc: Callback called at the end of the drag. Resets the counter to 0 (no undo action is added here).

gizmoDragging.desc: Callback called on every drag update: increments the counter then, depending on the mode, calls translateFn / rotateFn / scaleFn with editor.getAxisGizmoTransform().

registerEditorPreferences.desc: Registers `dynamicDecalsTool.gizmo`: displayBoundingBox (bool, true), boundingBoxColor (RGBA {1,0,0,0.75}, with color picker) and displayDebugObjWhileMovingControlPoints (bool, true).

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

editModeUpdate.desc: Called every frame by the editor's edit mode: updates and draws the gizmo if a mode is active, draws the bounding box of the selected decal, then the debug sphere of the control points.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: stores the tool and the editor_api_dynamicDecals API.
